selftext:
Hello everyone,

I'll try to keep this as short as possible.

I'm from Sudan, and I'm currently a university student. A short while ago, my parents sent me money to cover my university tuition fees. Unfortunately, I lost all of it trading.

Now, my university education and future are at risk, and I have nothing left.

If you can help me, please consider donating anything, even just $1. Every dollar makes a difference to me.

And if you can't help, please just scroll past this post without judging me or making accusations.

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Tron
